Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.efo_id AS indication_curie, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno, then INNER JOIN compound_records on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno, then INNER JOIN compound_structures on compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter where molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 and drug_indication.mesh_heading contains 'neoplasm'. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
